answer: The economy traces shared funding sources, co-spent outputs, and tight timing correlations to group identities into clusters. A lone funder feeding many keys emerges like a vein in marble, while accounts that attest in lockstep stand out as a falcon's shadow. Each cluster gets a discount on its attestations, so a lagoon of coordinated sybils cannot flood reputation. Honest agents keep full weight, so buying influence stays expensive as every linked identity dilutes the rest.
